data.name: Ameen
data.gender_notes: Ameen is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is relied upon, trustworthy, honest, and reliable. The name Ameen carries the meaning “Trustworthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Ameen usually hope their child will grow to embody trustworthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies faith, trust, and reliance on Allah.
data.etymology: Ameen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trustworthy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ameen total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ameen" holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic community as it is commonly used during supplications or duas. In Islamic tradition, when concluding a dua, Muslims say "Ameen" which means "I believe it (your prayer) to be true" or "May it be (your prayer) true." This phrase reinforces the concept of trust in Allah and the importance of making sincere and heartfelt prayers.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Ameen" symbolizes trustworthiness and reliability before Allah. This name serves as a reminder for individuals to always strive to develop fairness, trustworthiness, and sincerity in their actions and thoughts. By living up to the name "Ameen," individuals demonstrate their commitment to being a person of integrity and trustworthiness in the eyes of Allah and their community.
